commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Half-chance! Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) plays a pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
87' Borja Jimenez prepares a substitution. Dani Raba is replaced by Duk (Leganes).
85' The attendance is 22533.
83' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luken Beitia (Real Sociedad) is coming onto the pitch as Aritz Elustondo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' 3 - 0 Goal! Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 3:0.
80' Real Sociedad win a corner.
79' Offside again. Dani Raba (Leganes) couldn't find the way to beat the offside trap and has been caught a few times today.
78' Leganes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' Dani Raba (Leganes) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play and Leganes have been awarded a corner kick.
76' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
74' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
73' Seydouba Cisse will be replaced by Roberto Lopez (Leganes).
73' Borja Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javi Hernandez (Leganes) replacing Adria Altimira.
70' The linesman signals that Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
68' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle as Dani Raba (Leganes) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
66' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
66' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Orri Oskarsson will be replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
66' The substitution has been made. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) has replaced Takefusa Kubo.
65' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

65' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Sociedad will take a corner.
63' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
61' That's a clear yellow card. Renato Tapia (Leganes) goes into the book.
61' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
59' Dani Raba (Leganes) serves up a nice cross, but Alex Remiro punches the ball away.
58' Although Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) is just on the bench, Francisco Maeso has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
56' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
56' Leganes earn a corner.
55' Dani Raba (Leganes) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Alex Remiro anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
54' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) is caught offside!
53' Here is a change. Juan Cruz is going off and Borja Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes).
53' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) replaces Diego Garcia.
50' Leganes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

50' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Leganes have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

48' 2 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the left side of the goal and makes it 2:0. Marko Dmitrovic was helpless.
47' Adria Altimira (Leganes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) comes on the pitch for Arsen Zakharyan.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Francisco Maeso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) strikes from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Dani Raba (Leganes) sends a long ball in, but Alex Remiro comfortably gathers the ball.
44' Juan Cruz (Leganes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
42' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
41' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
39' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
39' Referee Francisco Maeso sees the trip by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
37' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies well wide of the left post.
34' The game is interrupted as Juan Cruz (Leganes) is flagged offside.
32' Imanol Alguacil is forced to make a change. Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) is unable to continue due to injury, Jon Martin comes on.
28' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle.
24' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Dani Raba (Leganes) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
20' It looked like the long-range shot by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
17' Dani Raba (Leganes) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
16' Real Sociedad force their opponents to concede a corner.
15' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the top left corner, but Marko Dmitrovic keeps it out with an amazing save.
12' 1 - 0 Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the left post in trademark fashion.
11' The Real Sociedad players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' A lofted cross from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
8' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Dani Raba (Leganes) heads on.
5' Dani Raba (Leganes) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
2' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Real Sociedad will kick the game off.
Francisco Maeso will officiate today.
